object.attr: derived: CF-S45, CF-S46, E5, E17, F3. The check for a changed file leaves a moment before the replace; between the GUI and MCP servers that moment can be closed. TEAM.md's one writer per document isn't enforced. Decided on 2026-11-10 (Q-S3): wait, then refuse.
object.description: While one Mellon process runs an operation that writes files of a document, Mellon shall hold back each operation of another Mellon process that writes files of that document.
